reviews.t: Cheaply made, frizzy hair, NO CURLS

There's a weird comb on the side of the plates that doesn't do anything other than pull more hair. I tried twice to make this thing work and both times ended up with no curl but strips of frizz that I had to flat iron with my original flat iron and barely succeeded in making the two strips I did do not look frizzy. The heat control is amazing as I have naturally curly, very thick hair. I am very happy with this product and can use it before working 12 hours and still have professional looking hair at the end of the day. Would definitely buy again.

I got this iron because it looked similar to the much pricier Tyme hair straighteners, which I had always wanted to try.  To be honest, I didn't like how it curled my hair. It’s also great for when you’re in a hurry and don’t have time to wait to the tool to cool off before putting away. I also like how it comes with 2 hair clips (handy for when styling), a fine tooth comb, and a heat proof glove.  I like the hot the tool gets. Anyone who has hard time curling with regular curler then this is great product. I have always struggle to have a good curls on the regular curler. By regular curler i meant is curler without a curl angle. This curler has an curl angle in which you dont have to twist your hand while curling. Which is awesome for me and makes it user friendly The curls came out really good for the first time user. Also the iron heats up fast as well. Packaging itself is really good.

I love this thing! I have been searching for a way to smooth my hair while also giving it a soft spiral curl. This is so much easier to use than my flat iron. It really makes a beautiful curl. There is less heat damage as the hair goes through quickly.  It does not pull on your hair. It even combs it making sure the curl is super smooth and shiny. This is so much better than any of my other tools. Great invention!

reviews.t: Box full of wants and needs for this straightener
reviews.x: A product that I gifter my wife with. She loved it. She has been using this daily since and she says its a great buy for the price. Its easy to use and also the package comes with a lot of accesories that we need for the particular straightener. The heat is stable and well controlled. Definitely would recommend for the quality for the price and the contents in the box

I like how it is a straightener and curling iron all in one. It makes cute curls. The only thing that I don’t like about it is that it’s hard to keep the hair in it while curling it. Maybe it just takes some practice since I’m not used to using a straightener to curl my hair. Overall good product

I was so excited to get this in but sadly it is very hard to use and the combs on it rip out my hair. I've tried several times to use it today but have been unsuccessful of achieving the curl i was wanting i just lost hair. It doesn't work anything like it shows on the video.

This did such a good job on my hair! I loved how smooth it made my hair!!! Posted before and after pictures. Temperature control is great! Super easy to use. Like that it has auto shutoff. Didn't feel like it was the type of straightener to overheat/burn my hair.

reviews.t: Had it for over an year, used may be 12-15 times and doesn't turn on anymore. Quality is poor.
reviews.x: I normally don't use straightners so bought this machine to use occasionally.  I used it for may be 12-15 times in the last year and the machine doesn't turn on anymore.  Very disappointed with the quality and for the price I paid, expected it to last longer.

This is exactly what I was looking for! The grip is fantastic and allows me to curl my hair with ease. I was worried with some reviews complaining about the little comb bumps but that did not get snagged in my hair. Excellent product and value for the cost!

claims.text: Many reviewers report the tool pulls, snags, or breaks hair, especially due to the comb/teeth.
Several users say it fails to curl or straighten effectively, leaving hair frizzy or kinky.
Positive reviewers praise the fast heating and strong heat control, especially for thick hair.
Some reviewers find curling requires practice, though several say it becomes easy with use.
A few reviewers report the unit was defective or caused severe damage out of the box.
